prompts.snack: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production 2D beat-em-up animation atlas. Image 1 is the EXACT existing game machine; preserve its design, colors, weapons, materials, illustrated shading and identity. Make one square 2048x2048 sheet on GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, exactly 4 equal columns and 4 equal rows, 16 complete separate drawings. Same three-quarter side view facing screen RIGHT, fixed camera, consistent body size and perspective, centered in each cell with at least 30px inner transparent gutter; never cross cell boundaries. No grid lines, text, labels, environment, floor or cast shadows. Read row-major: frames0–7 EIGHT DISTINCT consecutive locomotion phases with actual articulated motion and visible changing silhouettes, NOT merely translating/tilting one image; frames8–11 attack anticipation, acceleration, extended contact, recovery; frame12 recoil from impact; frames13–15 losing balance, falling, disabled. Maintain attached mechanical joints, avoid duplicated/missing parts. Keep roots aligned and same baseline per cell, except genuinely airborne machines. The lunch delivery quadrotor with red camera eye and metal cooler: frames0–7 rotor blades genuinely rotate through eight angles with small natural banking, cooler suspension sways, all four rotor assemblies remain attached; frames8–11 aiming red eye, opening front firing mechanism, red pulse discharge, recoil/reset; frames13–15 failing rotors, dropping diagonally, lying broken on floor.

prompts.cleaner: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production 2D beat-em-up game sprite atlas.
